Definition: neuter of a derivative of G4072; a flying animal, i.e. bird:--bird, fowl.
BiblicalUsage: Peteinon is a bird, a fowl, any flying creature. Jesus says to look at the fowls of the air, which neither sow nor reap nor gather into barns, yet the heavenly Father feeds them, and He asks how much more He will feed His people. The same birds appear in the parable of the sower, snatching the seed that falls by the wayside.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the birds preach two sermons at once: God feeds what cannot feed itself, and the devil snatches what is sown on hard ground.
